title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Amending the State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Earnestly Studying and Implementing the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Amending the National Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China

Fa Fa [2010] No. 13

All local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

On April 29, 2010, the 14th Session of the Standing Committee of the 11th National People's Congress deliberated and adopted the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress on Amending the National Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China. The amended National Compensation Law abolishes the confirmation procedure, unblocks the channels for claims, changes the principles of imputation, expands the scope of compensation, improves the compensation procedure, adds provisions on burden of proof and cross-examination, clarifies personnel allocation, strengthens supervision over compensation, raises compensation standards, and improves funding guarantees. This is of great significance for further advancing the three key tasks proposed by the Central Committee, promoting state organs to exercise their functions and powers in accordance with the law, protecting the lawful rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, and safeguarding social fairness, justice, harmony, and stability. It is an important task for the people's courts to thoroughly study, publicize, and implement the Decision on Amending the National Compensation Law. The relevant work is hereby notified as follows:

1. People's courts at all levels shall organize all judicial officers to carefully study the Decision on Amending the National Compensation Law adopted by the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress, accurately grasp and deeply understand the content of the amendments, raise awareness, and unify thinking. In light of actual conditions, they shall actively carry out publicity work on the National Compensation Law, highlighting its positive significance and typical cases in strengthening the protection of human rights, providing relief to the interests of the disadvantaged, and promoting state organs to exercise their functions and powers in accordance with the law, thereby demonstrating the good image of the people's courts in administering justice for the people.

2. People's courts at all levels shall change their mindset, overcome difficulties, earnestly implement the National Compensation Law, actively accept and cautiously handle national compensation cases, strengthen coordination in handling such cases, and ensure that the compensation decisions made by the Compensation Committee of the court are implemented without any compromise. They shall review and revise various rules and regulations, further standardize the procedures for handling various types of cases in accordance with the new provisions and requirements of the National Compensation Law, improve the quality of adjudication and enforcement work, take effective measures to reduce erroneous cases, and effectively raise the level of fair justice.

3. Leaders of people's courts at all levels shall attach great importance to national compensation work and actively coordinate with relevant departments to establish and adjust the institutions handling national compensation cases. All higher people's courts and intermediate people's courts shall promptly consult with the organizational and personnel establishment departments to actively implement the new provisions on the establishment of the Compensation Committee in the Decision on Amending the National Compensation Law, and ensure that there are at least three adjudicators as members of the Compensation Committee of the people's court. The principal leaders of basic people's courts shall personally inquire into and take responsibility for the national compensation cases of the court, and shall set up a specialized compensation handling team or designate specific personnel to handle cases where the court itself is the compensation-obliged authority.

4. People's courts at all levels shall expedite the conclusion of pending cases such as national compensation confirmation, pay attention to the investigation and study of new situations and problems, and make full preparations during the transition period before the Decision on Amending the National Compensation Law takes effect.

It is hereby notified.

May 10, 2010
